messages:
Rachel C: FYI Stretto reported ~3x p99 on hosted endpoint since ~08:30 UTC. Ticket INC-4821. Anyone free to triage?

Sahil: grabbing logs now. do we have a sample request + model version?

Rachel C: sample request pasted below, model is gpt-small-v2 pinned. customer says spike started after a deploy around 07:45 UTC.
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDDIE\" \ 
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-small-v2\",\"input\":\"Summarize the document\"}'
```

Cheng: looking at infra metrics — kvcache miss rate jumped from ~2% to ~32% around 07:46. graph: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/kv/stretto-miss-rate

Linda: I can run a replay on staging. can someone hand me the exact request id or example payload?

Rachel C: request id in ticket: r-20210317-8a7f. pasted logs show many retries with 503 from model-worker.

Sahil: running a perf harness against the customer's routing pool now. command:
```
./tools/rt-bench --target pool-stretto --qps 40 --duration 120 --profile /tmp/stretto.prof
```
ETA ~3m.

Deploy Bot: rollout event: runtime/selector v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 deployed to pool-stretto at 2024-10-18T07:44:00Z.

Cheng: that matches. kernel_selector default flipped to 'auto-l2' in v1.12.4 which can change memory layout. replaying locally with the new selector I see large memcpy stalls in the profiler.

Rami: can we try reverting selector to 'legacy' for pool-stretto as a hotfix? if that reduces memcpy stalls we can confirm.

Sahil: I'll push a config override to pool-stretto (3 nodes at a time). patch:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  kernel_selector: legacy
```
Rolling in 2m.

Sahil: rolling restart started. will monitor p99 and kvcache miss.

(3m later)

Cheng: after rolling first batch (nodes a/b/c), profiler shows memcpy stall time down ~70%. kvcache miss rate trending back to 3-4%. sample p99: before 430ms -> now ~115ms on synthetic replay.

Rachel C: customer call at 11:15 UTC; I'll update INC-4821 and let them know we have a mitigation and are validating.

Linda: ran staging replay against v1.12.4 with selector override and saw same improvement. good candidate for urgent rollback/patch.

Sahil: completed roll over pool-stretto. monitoring remains green for 10m.

Rami: can we add a guard so kernel_selector changes require a perf-compare gate? open to making it a rollout flag.

Cheng: will capture flamegraphs + kvcache traces and open a PR: add perf-regression check for selector changes + a runtime flag to opt-in. assigning to me.

Rachel C: thanks all. updating customer and closing the immediate escalations. please add notes to INC-4821 and mark for postmortem. :thumbsup:

Sahil: filing follow-up ticket PF-739 (postmortem + config-gate). tag @chung for review.

Cheng: I'll have flame graphs + reproducer in the PR by EOD.

Rachel C: great, marking thread resolved for now. if anything flares up I'll ping here.
